subject: Zenify onboarding: missing purchase reference, spend cap alignment and line-item split
messages:
From: Alina Rossi <alina@zenify.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenify.ai
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenify onboarding form + missing PO reference

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is our completed onboarding packet (Zenify_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf) and an initial line-item spreadsheet (PO_Lineitem_Spreadsheet.xlsx). Procurement at our side is ready to issue a PO once we confirm Redwood's purchase reference format and the spend cap that will be applied for the initial month.

Two specific asks we have:
- Can Redwood confirm the PO / purchase-ref pattern we should include (we have an internal PO# but need to map it to your Purchase Reference number scheme)?
- We split the line items across Product seats, Storage, and Priority Support. Can you confirm any spend cap buckets so we don't hit an auto-block during provisioning?

We noticed one mismatch in the spreadsheet where Item 3 (Priority Support) has quantity 1 but unit price is listed as the monthly enterprise rate; we assumed it's pro-rata for a 14-day onboarding. If Redwood requires explicit line-level remarks we can resubmit.

Attaching the two files for reference.

Thanks,
Alina Rossi
Head of Partnerships | Zenify AI
Alina Rossi
alina@zenify.ai
Attachment: Zenify_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: PO_Lineitem_Spreadsheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Zenify onboarding form + missing PO reference

Forwarding Zenify's onboarding packet — they need a purchase reference mapping and clarification on spend cap buckets. Noted the line-item oddity on Priority Support (pro-rata).

Ben: can procurement generate a provisional Purchase Reference (PUR-...) and tell them the spend cap buckets they should hit for the first 30 days? Also, if we need the line to be split differently for billing (e.g., separate prorated support charge), please flag.

Monica / Kimberly: FYI — this potential account will be on a Dedicated capacity POC; we need procurement and billing to coordinate the provisional PO issuance so provisioning isn't blocked.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Alliances Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

--- Forwarded message ---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Alina Rossi <alina@zenify.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zenify onboarding form + missing PO reference

Marcus / Monica / Kimberly / Alina,

Thanks for the packet, Alina — we've reviewed the worksheet and onboarding form. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary of issues found:
- No Redwood Purchase Reference provided: we'll issue a provisional PUR-2025-ZEN-3241 that you should include in all invoices and the PO header.
- Spend cap buckets: initial provisioning will use two buckets for the trial month:
  * compute/billable tokens: cap $12,000
  * support & services: cap $3,000
  * storage/backups: cap $1,500
- Line-item correction: as you noted, the Priority Support line (row 3) needs to be split into two entries: Support (prorated onboarding charge) and Ongoing Priority Support (monthly). We request a clarified row with two lines and a note for proration period.

Requested documents from Zenify to finalize issuance:
1) Signed-Zenify-Onboarding (the PDF is missing the Procurement signature block on page 2).
2) Revised line-item spreadsheet with Priority Support split into two rows and an explicit proration note.
3) Billing contact and remit-to address for invoicing.

Once we have those, procurement will attach the provisional purchase reference PUR-2025-ZEN-3241 and confirm the spend caps in the PO metadata. We can also set a soft-alert (email) when 80% of any bucket is reached; please confirm who should receive those alerts.

Action owners / timeline:
- Zenify (Alina): return signature + corrected spreadsheet by EOD Wed 9 Sep.
- Ben (procurement): issue provisional PUR and share PO stub once docs received (T+1 business day).
- Monica (billing): confirm remit-to and enable alerts for 80% thresholds.

Alina, I can issue the provisional PUR and a PO stub (non-binding) so provisioning can proceed while final contract redlines are addressed. Let me know if Zenify prefers placeholder PO number or to use your internal PO mapped to our PUR.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_stub_example.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alina Rossi <alina@zenify.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zenify onboarding form + missing PO reference

Hi Alina — thanks for the quick follow. A few firm items from billing: 

1) Remit-to: Please send an invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.com with your full remit-to address. If Zenify will bill from a European entity, include VAT registration.
2) Alerts: We'll set the 80% bucket alerts to go to alina@zenify.ai and finance-ops@zenify.ai (please confirm that second address).
3) Provisional PO: Ben, please attach the provisional PUR-2025-ZEN-3241 to the Zenify onboarding doc bundle once issued.

Alina — we reviewed the Priority Support split and attached below a short sample of how the two lines should look in your spreadsheet: 
- Support (Onboarding, 14 days): qty 1 | unit description: prorated support | amount: $700 | note: prorated 14/30
- Ongoing Priority Support (monthly): qty 1 | unit price: $1,500 | note: starts post-onboarding cycle

If you can upload the corrected PO_Lineitem_Spreadsheet.xlsx to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cZenifyOnboard) and return the signed PDF, Ben and I will finish the provisional purchase reference and schedule the soft-alerts.

Thanks — we'll aim to have the provisional PO stub out by tomorrow afternoon after receiving the corrected spreadsheet.

Best,
Monica Patel
Billing Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_line_split.csv (text/csv)
